description: Building Identification Number.
Borough-Block-Lot of the tax lot used to join PLUTO (MAPPLUTO_BBL; DOF billing BBL for condominiums).
Borough (always 'Manhattan', i.e. BIN starting with 1; includes Marble Hill).
2020 NTA code of the building.
2020 NTA name of the building.
ZIP code of the building.
'address_point_same_bin' or 'nearest_address_point_50m' (fallback when the BIN has no address point); empty if unavailable.
Longitude of the area-weighted footprint centroid.
Latitude of the area-weighted footprint centroid.
Longitude of the delivery point: address point with the same BIN nearest to the centroid, else the centroid.
Latitude of the delivery point.
'address_point' or 'centroid'.
House number and street of the selected address point.
Footprint area computed from the polygon geometry (SHAPE_AREA is not used: it is computed in Web Mercator).
Year construction was completed; missing where the source reports 0 or null.
Roof height above ground level (source in feet, converted with 0.3048); missing where the source reports 0.
Lowest elevation at building ground level (source in feet, converted).
Number of floors of the tallest building on the tax lot (lot-level attribute repeated for every building on the lot).
PLUTO land-use category code (1-11).
Label of the land-use code.
Department of Finance building class (e.g. C4, D1, O5).
First letter of bldgclass.
Label of the building class group.
Residential units summed over all buildings on the tax lot (proxy for delivery demand).
Residential and non-residential units summed over all buildings on the tax lot.
Gross floor area of all buildings on the tax lot (source in sq ft, converted).
Number of buildings on the tax lot according to PLUTO.
Year of the (second most recent) alteration; missing if never altered (0 in source).
Year of the most recent alteration when altered more than once.
max(yearalter1, yearalter2). Alterations after 1992 are subject to the ADA Standards.
Tax-lot frontage along the street (source in ft).
Building frontage along the street (source in ft; building 1 of the lot).
Building depth (source in ft; building 1 of the lot).

PLUTO BsmtCode: 0 none, 1 above-grade full, 2 below-grade full, 3 above-grade partial, 4 below-grade partial, 5 unknown. Above-grade basements (brownstones, row houses) usually imply a raised first floor and a stoop.
PLUTO ProxCode: 0 not available, 1 detached, 2 semi-attached, 3 attached.
Lot lies in an LPC historic district.
Name of the LPC historic district.
Lot contains an individual and/or interior landmark.
Landmark designation text as in PLUTO.
PLUTO release used (26v1).
Planar distance from the delivery point to the nearest sidewalk polygon (0 if inside one).

Planar distance from the delivery point to the nearest vehicular street centreline (CSCL: constructed, roadbed type street, excluding non-vehicular segments). Approximates entrance setback from the roadway.
Number of address points sharing the BIN (0 = none; >1 often indicates several entrances or a corner building).
Number of buildings in this table on the same tax lot (BBL). Lot-level PLUTO fields (e.g. numfloors) are shared by all of them.
Quality flag: single-building lot whose roof height per floor is < 2 m or > 8 m (likely error in height or floors).
Footprint capture method ('Photogrammetric' or 'Other (Manual)').
A Street View image was downloaded for this building (8 neighbourhoods).
The image was annotated by the multimodal model (record streetview_entrance_labels.csv).
Longitude of the requested camera location (nearest point on the street centreline).
Latitude of the requested camera location.
Geodesic distance between the requested camera location and the target point.
Requested camera heading (planar bearing from camera to target in lon/lat degrees).
Requested horizontal field of view.
Street View panorama ID when recorded (cacheable under the Street View Static API terms).
Capture date of the panorama when recorded by the metadata request.

Group ID shared by buildings whose requests were near-identical (camera within 1 m, heading within 5 deg), i.e. the model saw the same image; empty otherwise. Useful to assess annotation repeatability.
Quality flag: camera location more than 30 m from the target (entrance may be small or occluded).
Quality flag: panorama captured before 2020 (conditions may have changed); false also when the date is unknown.
AI: the entrance or its access conditions can be interpreted at least partially.
AI: visible stairs/steps at or immediately before the entrance (empty if not usable).
Visible gate/fence/barrier at the entrance after the targeted human review (see gate_ramp_source); empty if the image is not usable or the reviewers could not judge it.
Visible ramp after the targeted human review (see gate_ramp_source); empty as for gate_present.
Primary label (AI + human review): 1 if no gate and (no stairs or ramp present), from stairs_present, gate_present, ramp_present; empty if the image is not usable or the reviewers could not judge it.

Origin of gate_present/ramp_present: ai (AI reported neither feature and the image was not drawn as a review control; AI value kept), human_review (targeted review; with two annotators a feature counts if at least one saw it), human_validation_set_a (answers from validation Set A), human_review_not_judgeable (selected for review but the annotators could not judge the entrance; gate, ramp and label left empty). Empty if the image is not usable.
AI: visible gate/fence/barrier at the entrance, as reported by the model (empty if not usable).
AI: visible ramp, as reported by the model (empty if not usable).
AI-only label: same rule applied to stairs_present, gate_present_ai, ramp_present_ai; empty if not usable.
Secondary label: the model's holistic judgement that a sidewalk robot could reach the door area.
Model snapshot that produced the annotation.
API response identifier (links to streetview_ai_raw_outputs.jsonl).
Primary index: predicted probability that the entrance is accessible under the rule label after the human review of gates and ramps (accessible_rule), from the final logistic model.
100 x p_accessible.
5th percentile of p_accessible over bootstrap refits (parameter uncertainty only).
95th percentile of p_accessible over bootstrap refits.
Out-of-fold probability from 5-fold CV (only for buildings with a training label). Use this, not p_accessible, to compare with labels.
Alternative index: same model specification trained on the AI-only label (accessible_rule_ai).
100 x p_accessible_ai_only.
5th percentile of p_accessible_ai_only over bootstrap refits.
95th percentile of p_accessible_ai_only over bootstrap refits.
Out-of-fold probability of the AI-only index (only for buildings with an AI-only training label).
Building lies in one of the seven labelled neighbourhoods.
Land use and building class each occur >= 5 times among training labels.
All observed numeric predictors within the 1st-99th percentile of the training sample.
in_training_nta AND categories_seen AND numeric_in_range.
Version tag of the model specification.
